What we do

Advice on the side of the buyer, never the listing.

We take no commission from sellers or developers. Our fee is paid by you, so our advice answers only to you.

      Four steps from first brief to keys in hand.

      i

      Listen

      A working session on goals, timeline, financing and the trade-offs you will and won't make.

      Week 1
      ii

      Search

      We screen listed and off-market stock, then shortlist five to eight properties we would buy ourselves.

      Weeks 2 to 6
      iii

      Diligence

      Title, approvals, structural survey, pricing evidence and a clear view of what could go wrong.

      Weeks 6 to 9
      iv

      Close

      We negotiate, coordinate lawyers and lenders, and stay on through handover and fit-out.

      Weeks 9 to 14
